documents.title: Acorn Account Security
documents.text: Fictional account security guide: Two-factor authentication is configured under Account, Security. Administrators can require an authenticator app for all members. Keep recovery codes in a safe place; support cannot recover a lost authenticator for you.

documents.title: Acorn Notification Preferences
documents.text: Fictional notification preferences guide: Choose which project events appear in the activity feed under Preferences, Notifications. You can mute a project while retaining direct mentions. Quiet hours suppress desktop alerts until the selected morning time.

documents.title: Acorn Keyboard Shortcuts
documents.text: Fictional keyboard shortcuts guide: Press the question-mark key to display available keyboard shortcuts. Use the arrow keys to move between cards and Enter to open the selected card. These shortcuts work when the focus is outside an editable text field.

documents.title: Acorn File Attachments
documents.text: Fictional file attachments guide: Drag an image onto a card to attach it. Images can have an optional caption and may be reordered by a project editor. Removing a card attachment does not remove the original file from your computer.

documents.title: Acorn Accessibility Preferences
documents.text: Fictional accessibility preferences guide: Select high contrast under Preferences, Appearance to increase visual contrast. Reduced motion follows the operating system setting. All card actions are available from the keyboard menu.

documents.title: Acorn Project Archiving
documents.text: Fictional archiving projects guide: Archive an inactive project from its project menu to hide it from the active list. Project editors can restore archived projects from the archive view. Archiving preserves cards and comments.

documents.title: Acorn Enterprise Billing
documents.text: Fictional enterprise contract: Enterprise annual subscriptions have a 90-day refund request window from purchase. This enterprise policy applies only to the enterprise collection.
